# Ayush Bhalerao

> Electronics & Telecommunication engineering student (DSCE Bangalore), building toward edge AI / embedded ML engineering roles at the hardware-software-ML intersection. Ships fast, writes up what breaks, and has already put real systems in front of real users rather than just coursework.

## About

- Based in Pune, India. ECE undergrad at DSCE Bangalore.
- Prior production engineering experience at an early-stage edtech startup (since acquired); does freelance backend/web work (Go, Cloudflare, GCP).
- Five-year goal: end-to-end ownership of an inference stack, at places like Qualcomm, ARM, or an Apple Neural Engine / edge-AI team. Optimizing for shipped systems, not a PhD.


## Flagship work

- [betjee — virtual prediction market](https://ahhyoushh.github.io/betjee/): built in 24 hours for JEE exam-shift predictions, picked up organically on r/JEENEETards, scaled to 1.2M requests / 2.3K users on a free tier. Rebuilt as a real-time version with WebSockets and binary LMSR: https://ahhyoushh.github.io/betjee_v2/
- FPGA Mini NPU: a from-scratch 12-phase Verilog systolic array accelerator with an ESP32 host, UART driver, and a working quantization pipeline — his most hardware-differentiated project, aimed squarely at NPU/accelerator teams.
- Currently making a cost-model-driven CPU/iGPU/NPU backend selector for vector similarity search on AMD's XDNA1 NPU, built on the IRON/mlir-aie toolchain, with verified end-to-end NPU correctness and benchmarked throughput at scale.
- [sakurafetch](https://github.com/ahhyoushh/sakurafetch), [no-cursor](https://github.com/ahhyoushh/no-cursor) (local LLM-integrated CLI editor), [FileSense](https://github.com/ahhyoushh/FileSense) — full list at /projects/.
